content: कुप् I. €4 <ab>P.</ab> (कुप्यति, चुकोप, अकुपत्, कोपितुम्, कुपित) .²1 To be angry, (generally with the <ab>dat.</ab> of the person who is the object of anger, but sometimes with the <ab>acc.</ab> or <ab>gen.</ab> also); कुप्यन्ति हितवादिने <ls>K. 108</ls>; कुपितश्चन्द्रगुप्तश्चाणक्यस्योपरि <ls>Mu. 2</ls>; <ls>M. 3. 21</ls>; <ls>U. 7</ls>; चुकोप तस्मै स भृशम् <ls>R. 3. 56</ls>. .²2 To be excited, to gather strength, be virulent; as in दोषाः प्रकुप्यन्ति <ls>Suśr.</ls> --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (कोपयति-ते) .²1 To provoke, irritate; to excite, agitate. .²2 To stir up. --II. €10 <ab>U.</ab> .²1 To shine. .²2 To speak.
